CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY: Legacy credential-file directory; environment-only boot input.
DISCORD_API_BASE: Discord REST API origin; not dashboard-selectable.
DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN: Legacy Discord authentication token; never stored in guild settings.
DISCORD_GOODBYE_CHANNEL_IDS: Channels used for session-mode goodbye routing.
DISCORD_GUILD_ID: Legacy managed guild identifier; distinct from Container GUILD_ID.
DISCORD_LANDING_CHANNEL_IDS: Onboarding landing destinations for game-picker routing.
DISCORD_SESSION_LOBBY_VOICE_CHANNEL_ID: Voice lobby offered by session onboarding.
DISCORD_SESSION_LOOKING_TO_PLAY_CHANNEL_: Looking-to-play destination offered by session onboarding.
DISCORD_STAGING_BOT_TOKEN: Staging Discord authentication token; never rendered.
DISCORD_STAGING_GUILD_ID: Staging guild boundary; no ID is embedded in the reference.
DISCORD_TICKET_CATEGORY_ID: Category for newly opened ticket channels.
DISCORD_TICKET_STAFF_ROLE_ID: Staff role used by ticket authorization.
DISCORD_TOKEN: Container Discord authentication token; never stored in guild settings.
LOG_LEVEL: Container two_bot tracing level when RUST_LOG is unset (info default); RUST_LOG overrides.
TEMP_VOICE_ENABLED: Legacy temporary-voice enable flag; classification does not imply runtime wiring.
TWO_ANNOUNCEMENTS: Enable announcement command publication and routing.
TWO_ANTI_NUKE_DRY_RUN: Observe anti-nuke decisions without executing protective writes.
TWO_ANTI_NUKE_EVENT_MAX_AGE_SECONDS: Maximum age of anti-nuke events considered for action.
TWO_ANTI_NUKE_PROTECTED_USER_IDS: Accounts anti-nuke may not target; environment-only reach boundary.
TWO_ANTI_NUKE_TRUSTED_USER_IDS: Trusted accounts ignored by anti-nuke; environment-only reach boundary.
TWO_ASSISTANT_ENDPOINT: Template-assistant OpenAI-compatible endpoint; environment-only destination boundary.
TWO_ASSISTANT_MODEL: Template-assistant model name; environment-only so a web form cannot redirect it.
TWO_AUTOMATIONS: Enable automation administration and custom command publication/routing.
TWO_AUTOMOD_ALLOWED_DOMAINS: Domains permitted by the external-link matcher.
TWO_AUTOMOD_BAD_WORDS: Bad-word list normalized with NFKC and lowercase.
TWO_AUTOMOD_BLOCKED_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSION: Blocked attachment extensions, lowercase without a leading dot.
TWO_AUTOMOD_ENFORCE: Enable automod enforcement; absent/disabled remains dry-run.
TWO_AUTOMOD_MENTION_LIMIT: Mention threshold for automod (validated from 1 to 50).
TWO_AUTOMOD_SANCTIONS: Ordered violation ladder, starting at one; delete, warn or timeout actions.
TWO_BACKUP_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID: Backup object-store access credential; never rendered.
TWO_BACKUP_S3_BUCKET: Backup destination bucket; environment-only to prevent web-selected exfiltration.
TWO_BACKUP_S3_ENDPOINT: Backup object-store endpoint; environment-only destination boundary.
TWO_BACKUP_S3_PREFIX: Backup object-key prefix; environment-only destination boundary.
TWO_BACKUP_S3_REGION: Backup object-store region; environment-only destination boundary.
TWO_BACKUP_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: Backup object-store secret credential; never rendered.
TWO_BULK_JOIN_WINDOW_UNTIL: End of the temporary bulk-join window.
TWO_COMMUNITY_AUTOMATION_ACTOR_IDS: Automation actors excluded from human community activity.
TWO_COMMUNITY_CORRECTION_CYCLES: Non-negative count of operator scorecard corrections.
TWO_COMMUNITY_HUMAN_CHANNEL_IDS: Channels considered for human community activity.
TWO_COMMUNITY_RAID_ACTOR_IDS: Known raid actors excluded from human activity classification.
TWO_COMMUNITY_RECOMMENDATIONS: Permit scorecard recommendations unless explicitly disabled with 0.
TWO_COMMUNITY_SCORECARD: Enable the weekly scorecard job. Live fact capture is event attendance, message creation and rules acceptance only.
TWO_COMMUNITY_STAGING_ACTOR_IDS: Staging actors excluded from human community activity.
TWO_COMMUNITY_STAGING_GUILD_IDS: Staging guilds excluded from human community activity.
TWO_COMMUNITY_TEST_ACTOR_IDS: Test actors excluded from human community activity.
TWO_DATABASE_URL: Administrative/shared admission database credential required for live preflight, cutover and guild-config; must reach the same database as Container DATABASE_URL for the same token.
TWO_DB_POOL_MAX: Legacy database pool maximum read before the settings store exists.
TWO_FEED_POLL_SECONDS: Feed polling interval (validated from 60 to 86400 seconds).
TWO_HEALTH_BIND_HOST: Legacy health listener interface; environment-only network bind.
TWO_HEALTH_PORT: Legacy health listener port; Container uses LISTEN_ADDR instead.
TWO_INACTIVITY_DAYS: Inactivity horizon used for community nudges.
TWO_INTERNAL_ACTIONS: Master gate for website-origin internal actions; never dashboard-writable.
TWO_INTERNAL_ALLOW_ADD_MEMBER: Capability gate for internal member-add actions.
TWO_INTERNAL_ALLOW_AUTOMATIONS: Capability gate for internal automation actions.
TWO_INTERNAL_ALLOW_AUTOMATIONS_OVERWRITE: Separate capability gate for overwriting automations.
TWO_INTERNAL_ALLOW_MODERATION: Capability gate for internal moderation actions.
TWO_INTERNAL_ALLOW_SETTINGS: Capability gate for internal settings actions.
TWO_INTERNAL_BIND: Canonical combined IP:port for receiver configuration; a wildcard bind requires the Worker-set container marker (TOG-16851).
TWO_INTERNAL_BIND_HOST: Legacy split internal-action listener interface; receiver configuration uses TWO_INTERNAL_BIND instead.
TWO_INTERNAL_CALLERS: Signing-key-to-stable-caller mappings for receiver configuration; environment-only identity boundary, not loaded by Container bootstrap.
TWO_INTERNAL_CHANNEL_KEYS: Logical channel-key allowlist for internal actions.
TWO_INTERNAL_CONTAINER: Worker-set marker admitting a wildcard receiver bind; the container network is presumed private but unverified (TOG-16851).
TWO_INTERNAL_PORT: Legacy split internal-action listener port; receiver configuration uses TWO_INTERNAL_BIND instead.
TWO_INTERNAL_ROLE_KEYS: Logical role-key allowlist for internal actions.
TWO_MODERATION: Enable moderation command publication/routing; enabled mode requires Owen ID.
TWO_MODERATION_AUDIT_SECRET: Authentication secret for moderation audit handoff; never rendered.
TWO_MODERATION_PROTECTED_ROLE_IDS: Roles moderation may not target; environment-only reach boundary.
TWO_ONBOARDING_DRY_RUN: Suppress onboarding role writes, legacy/anchor welcomes and session goodbyes.
TWO_ONBOARDING_MODE: Onboarding selector: legacy, session or anchor; session suppresses role writes.
TWO_ONBOARDING_ROTA_MEASUREMENT: Dropped staging rota measurement gate; env-only refusal is retained.
TWO_ONBOARDING_ROTA_NOTICE: Dropped staging rota notice gate; env-only refusal is retained.
TWO_ONBOARDING_ROTA_PRIMARY_ACTOR_ID: Dropped staging rota primary actor; env-only refusal is retained.
TWO_ONBOARDING_ROTA_PSEUDONYM_KEY: Dropped rota pseudonym secret; env-only refusal is retained.
TWO_ONBOARDING_ROTA_READER_IDS: Dropped staging rota reader boundary; env-only refusal is retained.
TWO_OWEN_USER_ID: Owen bot identity, required and snowflake-validated when moderation is enabled.
TWO_RAID_JOIN_THRESHOLD: Join count threshold for the raid watch.
TWO_RAID_WINDOW_SECONDS: Join aggregation window for the raid watch.
TWO_REDIRECT_BIND_HOST: Legacy redirect listener interface; environment-only network bind.
TWO_REDIRECT_PORT: Legacy redirect listener port; environment-only network bind.
TWO_REDIRECT_TRUSTED_PROXIES: Trusted proxy boundaries for redirect request attribution.
TWO_SELF_ROLE_DRY_RUN: Observe self-role plans without writing roles.
TWO_SELF_ROLE_PANELS: Self-role panel catalog; preflight runs the same strict parser as gateway boot, which parks self-roles on invalid catalogues.
TWO_STAGING_DATABASE_URL: Staging database connection secret; never rendered.
TWO_STAGING_RESTART_CONTAINMENT: Staging restart containment gate; legacy boot input with no Next reader.
TWO_STAGING_RESTART_SYNTHETIC_ACTORS: Synthetic-actor allowlist for staging restart containment; legacy input with no Next reader.
TWO_TEMP_VOICE: Temporary-voice capability flag; classification does not imply runtime wiring.
TWO_TEMP_VOICE_CATEGORY_ID: Category for generated temporary voice rooms.
TWO_TEMP_VOICE_CREATE_COOLDOWN_SECONDS: Cooldown between a member's temporary-room creations.
TWO_TEMP_VOICE_DISABLED_CONTROLS: Temporary-room controls; classification does not imply runtime wiring.
TWO_TEMP_VOICE_EMPTY_GRACE_SECONDS: Grace period before an empty temporary room is removed.
TWO_TEMP_VOICE_GENERATOR_CHANNEL_ID: Voice channel used to request a temporary room.
TWO_TEMP_VOICE_MAX_PER_USER: Maximum temporary rooms owned by one member.
TWO_TEMP_VOICE_NAME_TEMPLATE: Temporary-room naming template; classification does not imply runtime wiring.
TWO_TEMP_VOICE_PROTECTED_CHANNEL_IDS: Channels temporary-room cleanup may not remove.
TWO_TEMP_VOICE_SYNTHETIC_HUMAN_IDS: Staging synthetic voice-test bots counted as human occupants; ignored for the live guild.
TWO_TEXT_COMMANDS: Enable optional text triggers only while automations are enabled.
